steps.name: Environment: install minimal OS deps, create non-root user, persist env and validate Node
steps.description: Install minimal Playwright/Chromium OS libraries non-interactively, create a non-root user 'pwuser' with a home directory, ensure the workspace is owned by pwuser, persist minimal environment via /etc/profile.d, and validate node/npm versions (fail if Node <16). This prevents interactive apt prompts and avoids permission issues when running npm/npx as pwuser.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-application-testing-with-playwright-43273/native_application"
export DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive
PKGS=(libgtk-3-0 libdbus-glib-1-2 libdbus-1-3 libnss3 libasound2 libx11-6 libxkbcommon0 libxcomposite1 libxdamage1 libxrandr2 libgbm1 libxss1 libu2f-udev libwayland-client0 libxcursor1 lsb-release ca-certificates fonts-liberation fonts-noto-color-emoji)
sudo apt-get update -q && sudo apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends "${PKGS[@]}" >/dev/null
sudo rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
# create pwuser if missing and ensure home exists
if ! id -u pwuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  sudo useradd -m -s /bin/bash pwuser || { echo "failed to create pwuser" >&2; exit 10; }
fi
# ensure workspace exists and is owned by pwuser
sudo mkdir -p "$WS" && sudo chown -R pwuser:pwuser "$WS"
# persist minimal env for future shells
sudo bash -c 'cat >/etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh <<"EOF"
export DISPLAY=${DISPLAY:-:99}
# add project local and user npm bin to PATH when present
[ -d "$HOME/.npm-global/bin" ] && export PATH="$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH"
EOF'
sudo chmod 644 /etc/profile.d/playwright_env.sh
# validate node/npm and version (Playwright requires Node >=16)
command -v node >/dev/null || { echo "node missing" >&2; exit 2; }
NODE_V_MAJOR=$(node -v | sed -E "s/^v([0-9]+).*/\1/")
if [ "$NODE_V_MAJOR" -lt 16 ]; then
  echo "node v16+ required, found $(node -v)" >&2
  exit 3
fi
command -v npm >/dev/null || { echo "npm missing" >&2; exit 4; }
node -v && npm -v

steps.name: Dependencies: install node modules and Playwright chromium with verification
steps.description: Run npm ci or npm i as pwuser to install devDependencies, fail on error (no masking). Then install only the Chromium browser binary via npx playwright install chromium using PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH for caching; verify browser artifacts exist by checking Playwright show-brief or the chromium executable under the browsers path. Ensure ownership is correct.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-application-testing-with-playwright-43273/native_application"
PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH=${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-"$WS/.cache/playwright-browsers"}
# install node deps as pwuser; prefer npm ci if lockfile exists
if [ -f "$WS/package-lock.json" ]; then
  sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npm ci --no-audit --progress=false"
else
  sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npm i --no-audit --progress=false"
fi
# ensure playwright is declared
sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && node -e 'const p=require("./package.json"); if(!(p.devDependencies&&p.devDependencies.playwright)||(typeof p.devDependencies.playwright!=="string")) { console.error("playwright not declared in devDependencies"); process.exit(2)}'"
# create cache path and ensure ownership
sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "mkdir -p '$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH'"
sudo chown -R pwuser:pwuser "$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH"
# install chromium binary via Playwright (retry simple loop)
RETRIES=3
for i in $(seq 1 $RETRIES); do
  if sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH' npx --yes playwright install chromium"; then
    break
  fi
  sleep $((i*2))
  if [ "$i" -eq "$RETRIES" ]; then
    echo "playwright browser install failed after $RETRIES attempts" >&2
    exit 20
  fi
done
# verify installation via playwright show-brief or presence of chromium executable
if ! sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH' npx --yes playwright show-brief | grep -i chromium >/dev/null 2>&1"; then
  # try direct check for a chromium binary under browsers path
  if ! sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "ls '$PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH' 2>/dev/null | grep -i chromium >/dev/null 2>&1"; then
    echo "Chromium browser not found in PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH" >&2
    exit 21
  fi
fi
sudo chown -R pwuser:pwuser "$WS"
sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npx --yes playwright --version"

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
# Run Playwright tests as pwuser with XDG_RUNTIME_DIR and sandbox control

: "${DISPLAY:=:99}"

  exit 4

sudo -u pwuser bash -lc '

# Use npx --yes to ensure local binary is used but allow PATH precedence

steps.name: Validation: build (npm ci/i), start local server robustly, run tests, stop server, surface evidence
steps.description: Build/install dependencies, start the http-server as pwuser, detect its PID robustly using pgrep for the server command, verify server readiness with retries, run Playwright tests, capture and report test result, then stop the server cleanly if owned by pwuser. Provide clear exit codes and logs for failures.
steps.script_code:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-application-testing-with-playwright-43273/native_application"
cd "$WS"
# ensure deps installed idempotently
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npm ci --no-audit --progress=false"
else
  sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npm i --no-audit --progress=false"
fi
# start server as pwuser in background
sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && setsid npm run start >/tmp/http-server.log 2>&1 &"
# give the server a moment then identify PID by matching the start command
sleep 1
SERVER_PID=$(pgrep -u pwuser -f "http-server -p 8080" | head -n1 || true)
if [ -z "$SERVER_PID" ]; then
  echo "failed to find http-server process" >&2
  tail -n 200 /tmp/http-server.log || true
  exit 30
fi
# validate PID is numeric and owned by pwuser
if ! echo "$SERVER_PID" | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' >/dev/null; then
  echo "invalid server pid: $SERVER_PID" >&2
  exit 31
fi
OWNER=$(ps -o user= -p "$SERVER_PID" | tr -d ' ')
if [ "$OWNER" != "pwuser" ]; then
  echo "server pid $SERVER_PID not owned by pwuser (owner=$OWNER)" >&2
  exit 32
fi
# readiness check
READY=1
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "curl -sfS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8080 >/dev/null"; then
    READY=0 && break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$READY" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "http-server not ready after timeout" >&2
  tail -n 200 /tmp/http-server.log || true
  kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  exit 33
fi
# run tests and capture exit code
set +e
sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && PATH='$WS/node_modules/.bin:$HOME/.npm-global/bin:$PATH' PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH='${PLAYWRIGHT_BROWSERS_PATH:-$WS/.cache/playwright-browsers}' XDG_RUNTIME_DIR='/tmp/xdg-runtime-pwuser' npx --yes playwright test --reporter=list"
TEST_RC=$?
set -e
# stop server if still running and owned by pwuser
if ps -p "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  OWNER=$(ps -o user= -p "$SERVER_PID" | tr -d ' ')
  if [ "$OWNER" = "pwuser" ]; then
    kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  fi
fi
# evidence
echo "VALIDATION: test exit code=$TEST_RC"
if [ "$TEST_RC" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "VALIDATION: SUCCESS"
  exit 0
else
  echo "VALIDATION: FAILURE - see /tmp/http-server.log and Playwright output" >&2
  tail -n 200 /tmp/http-server.log || true
  exit 40
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
PID_FILE="/tmp/http-server.pid"
if [ ! -f "$PID_FILE" ]; then
  echo "NOOP: no pid file ($PID_FILE)"
  exit 0
fi
SERVER_PID="$(cat "$PID_FILE")"
if [ -z "$SERVER_PID" ]; then
  echo "NOOP: pid file empty"
  exit 0
fi
if ! echo "$SERVER_PID" | grep -E '^[0-9]+$' >/dev/null; then
  echo "WARN: invalid pid in $PID_FILE: $SERVER_PID" >&2
  rm -f "$PID_FILE" || true
  exit 1
fi
if ! ps -p "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  echo "NOOP: process $SERVER_PID not running"
  rm -f "$PID_FILE" || true
  exit 0
fi
OWNER="$(ps -o user= -p "$SERVER_PID" | tr -d ' ')"
if [ "$OWNER" = "pwuser" ]; then
  kill "$SERVER_PID" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
  echo "STOPPED: pid=$SERVER_PID"
  rm -f "$PID_FILE" || true
  exit 0
else
  echo "REFUSE: pid $SERVER_PID not owned by pwuser (owner=$OWNER)" >&2
  exit 2
fi

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
WS="/home/kavia/workspace/code-generation/native-application-testing-with-playwright-43273/native_application"
cd "$WS"
# build (install deps)
if [ -f package-lock.json ]; then
  sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npm ci --no-audit --progress=false"
else
  sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "cd '$WS' && npm i --no-audit --progress=false"
fi
# start server
bash .init/start.sh
SERVER_PID="$(cat /tmp/http-server.pid || true)"
if [ -z "$SERVER_PID" ]; then
  echo "VALIDATION: failed to start server" >&2
  exit 30
fi
# readiness check: retry up to 30s
READY=1
for i in $(seq 1 30); do
  if sudo -u pwuser bash -lc "curl -sfS --max-time 2 http://127.0.0.1:8080 >/dev/null"; then
    READY=0 && break
  fi
  sleep 1
done
if [ "$READY" -ne 0 ]; then
  echo "VALIDATION: http-server not ready after timeout" >&2
  tail -n 200 /tmp/http-server.log || true
  bash .init/stop.sh || true
  exit 33
fi
# run tests
bash .init/test.sh
TEST_RC=$?
# stop server
bash .init/stop.sh || true
# evidence
echo "VALIDATION: test exit code=$TEST_RC"
if [ "$TEST_RC" -eq 0 ]; then
  echo "VALIDATION: SUCCESS"
  exit 0
else
  echo "VALIDATION: FAILURE - see /tmp/http-server.log and /tmp/playwright.test.rc and Playwright output" >&2
  tail -n 200 /tmp/http-server.log || true
  exit 40
fi
